(Currently Amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier in a diversified distribution manner; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over a portion of the carrier.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over a portion of the carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers comprising a selected subset of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, further comprising, for a second one of the symbols, allocating a distinct set of subcarriers to the second broadcast channel. 

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 6, the first broadcast channel comprising a first primary broadcast channel operable to carry diversified system information, and the second broadcast channel comprising a second primary broadcast channel operable to carry quick Page and optimized control information.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 7, further comprising setting a change indicator in the superframe preamble to indicate whether the system information for a subsequent superframe group has varied with respect to a previous superframe group.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 8, the subsequent superframe group comprising a first superframe, the first superframe comprising the superframe preamble.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 9, the previous superframe group comprising a first superframe, the first superframe comprising the superframe preamble.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 10, the change indicator comprising a digital signal in the control information.

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 11, a specified superframe comprising the superframe preamble, the superframe preamble comprising quick page and control information for the specified superframe, the control information for the specified superframe comprising the change indicator.

(Currently Amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe in an OFDM network, comprising: determining whether first broadcast channel data for a subsequent superframe group has varied with respect to first broadcast channel data for a previous superframe group; and setting a change indicator in the superframe preamble to indicate whether the first broadcast channel data for the subsequent superframe group has varied with respect to the first broadcast channel data for the previous superframe group. 

(Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 12, the subsequent superframe group comprising a first superframe, the first superframe comprising the superframe preamble.
